name: Contract Issue Spotting
description: Systematically surface contract clauses, inconsistencies, missing terms, operational obligations, and questions for qualified legal or business review without pretending issue-spotting is legal advice.

tasks.name: Establish contract context
tasks.objective: Identify parties, document set, governing transaction, jurisdiction if stated, business objectives, deal structure, operational dependencies, prior versions, exhibits, policies, and review authority.

tasks.name: Map operative terms
tasks.objective: Extract definitions, scope, term/renewal, pricing/payment, deliverables, acceptance, service levels, warranties, IP, data/privacy/security, confidentiality, compliance, insurance, indemnity, liability, termination, disputes, assignment, and change control.

tasks.name: Find conflicts and missing pieces
tasks.objective: Cross-check definitions, dates, amounts, exhibits, order forms, precedence clauses, incorporated documents, notice details, survival, dependencies, blank fields, circular references, and inconsistent obligations.

tasks.name: Assess operational and commercial impact
tasks.objective: Translate clauses into concrete duties, deadlines, dependencies, costs, evidence requirements, data handling, remedies, renewal/termination mechanics, and implementation burdens; flag questions needing legal judgment.

tasks.name: Compare against requirements or prior language
tasks.objective: Where a baseline exists, identify deviations, changed risk allocation, deleted protections, new obligations, fallback positions, and unresolved redlines with exact references.

tasks.name: Produce issue list for decision
tasks.objective: Deliver a clause-referenced issue matrix with category, text/location, concern, operational/business consequence, question, proposed discussion point, owner, and explicit items requiring qualified legal review.
